name: Sexy Mad Science
source:
Sexy Mad Science is the story of a lowly intern (you), attempting to become a Sexy Mad Scientist. Basically you mess with your new boss' older brother and earn points.

[From [url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/24035113/]Website[/url]]
translation:
《Sexy Mad Science》讲述一名地位卑微的实习生——也就是你——努力成为性感疯狂科学家的故事。简单来说，你要拿新老板的哥哥做些实验，从而赚取分数。

[摘自[url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/24035113/]网站[/url]]
